title: The Vacuum Awakens
subtitle: Henry clears a safe path through the hallway.

levels.title: Follow the Crumbs
levels.clue: Henry spots biscuit crumbs beside the laundry basket.

levels.title: Dust Bunny Detour
levels.clue: Match on the dusty tiles to clear a quiet path.

levels.title: Behind the Basket
levels.clue: Leo is tucked behind the basket. Clear the dust so Henry can see him.

levels.title: The Vacuum Wakes
levels.clue: The vacuum rumbles. Henry stands between it and Leo.

levels.title: A Quiet Corner
levels.clue: Clear the thickest dust and make Leo a quiet corner.

levels.title: Nap Behind the Hamper
levels.clue: Make matches beside sleeping Leos so Henry can bark them awake.

levels.title: Two Layers of Trouble
levels.clue: Some dust bunnies need two good matches before they tumble away.

levels.title: Henry Takes the Lead
levels.clue: Henry leads the way one clean pawstep at a time.

levels.title: The Great Wake-Up Call
levels.clue: Henry needs one more chorus of barks before everyone heads outside.

levels.title: Safe in the Sunshine
levels.clue: One final cleanup, then Henry and Leo can share the biscuit outside.
